acceptance_tests: the season's growth room is written down before intake opens, with the capacity figure, the expected returning demand and the remainder shown
each accepted new client is recorded against the allocation priority, and acceptances beyond the room are recorded as exceptions with who approved them
revisit_triggers: actual returning demand diverges from the expectation used to size the room
acceptances exceed the room in any season
the following season's retention for the existing base falls after a growth push

nodes.definition: Once a year, inside the working off-season and with the season's evidence assembled, review the book as a whole and take the decisions that are only visible from that altitude. Recompute retention by cohort and segment with the post-extension correction applied. Read the classified exit reasons against the retention mechanism map to see which force is actually failing rather than which one the practice assumed was holding. Review each off-season line against what it consumed in weeks and what it returned, and re-run it through the eligibility filter to confirm it still passes on authorization, competence, infrastructure and capacity. Look at the mix of the book by tier and at segment drift, since a practice can arrive somewhere it never chose to go one client at a time. Then decide next year's shape: which lines continue, which are capped or retired, which clients are not carried forward, how much growth room exists, and what the follow-up and positioning sequence will say. The output is a small set of written decisions with named owners and dates, because the characteristic failure of this review is a pleasant discussion in a quiet month that changes nothing before the next season begins.

included: annual assembly of retention, churn, line performance and book-mix evidence
re-running each line through the eligibility filter
the written decision set with owners and dates
the timing rule placing the review before the pre-season block
excluded: in-season corrective action
the practice-level economics and pricing recalibration owned by the practice-setup knowledge base
production control tuning owned by the return-workflow knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an unimplemented decision from the prior review, a materially changed recompute, or a shift in the book's segment mix

pros.claim: One assembled view exposes drift that no single season's decision would ever reveal
pros.example: seeing that the book has quietly become majority small-business over three years while the service model, pricing and slot design still assume individual returns

cons.claim: The review is expensive in the practice's scarcest asset, uninterrupted thinking time, and it is easy to hold too late to matter
cons.example: a thoughtful December review whose decisions cannot be implemented before intake opens weeks later

failure_modes: reviewing without written decisions, owners or dates
holding it after the pre-season block has already started
reading only the aggregate figures and missing a collapsing segment
carrying every line forward because none was formally re-tested
acceptance_tests: the review produces written decisions covering lines, clients not carried forward, growth room and the next-season sequence, each with a named owner and a date
the decision dates all fall before the pre-season block opens, and each off-season line carries a fresh eligibility verdict
revisit_triggers: any decision from the last review was never implemented
the post-extension recompute changes a figure the review relied on
a segment's share of the book shifts materially between reviews

edges.why_related: the retention denominator and numerator are literally the counting unit and the returned event the book definition pins
the forces are mapped onto defined client units and states, not onto an informal notion of who the clients are
the advice line is the specific application of the conduct boundary to inbound questions and published content
a line whose only viable pitch breaks the conduct rules fails the filter before authorization is even considered
the sequence can only contact the clients whose recorded permissions and preferences allow that class of message
the lapsed list that the exit routine works is produced by the retention computation
multi-year contribution can only be ranked over clients whose seasons have been counted consistently
positioning tells each client something specific, and the specifics come from the debrief notes
the extension list and the reason each return went on extension are captured in the debrief window
amendment work is offered only after the four-part filter clears it for authorization, competence, infrastructure and capacity
notice work sits closest to the representation boundary, so the authorization arm of the filter decides whether it may be offered at all
a recurring dated service is only accepted once the capacity and infrastructure arms of the filter have cleared it
the crossover is the line most likely to fail the competence and capacity arms, so the filter is what makes the decision honest
educational offers exist only inside the general side of the line the classification draws
the effort-adjusted ranking surfaces the candidates that the standards-based grounds are then applied to
the delivery contact in the sequence is where the single plain referral ask actually sits
the extension waves are the largest dated commitment the working block has to absorb
growth room can only be derived once the year's committed weeks and protected blocks are known
the annual review reads the dated cohort and segment figures the measurement work unit produces
every message in the sequence is checked against the never-say list and the disclosure rule before it is sent, whoever drafted it
the conduct rules govern how a non-renewal is delivered: early, in writing, without accusation, with documents offered
an educational mailing is a promotional-class message and may only reach clients whose recorded permissions cover it
notice help must stay documented-response support inside an engagement rather than becoming reassuring fact-specific commentary
only lines that cleared the filter are allowed to occupy weeks in the plan, and the capacity arm of the filter is answered from the plan
the ask is bounded by the no-pressure rule and by the requirement to verify whether compensated arrangements are permitted
monthly bookkeeping deliverables recur on their own schedule and land inside the recovery and pre-season blocks the plan protects
edges.resolution_rule: the protected blocks win: a crossover engagement is accepted only with a named performer and a written peak and pre-season coverage plan agreed before the first close, and where no such coverage exists the line is capped or declined rather than absorbed

edges.why_related: growth consumes the response speed and attention that produce the ease and proactivity forces holding the existing book
edges.resolution_rule: the returning base's expected demand is reserved first and growth is taken only from the remainder; any acceptance beyond the computed room requires a named capacity addition agreed before intake opens, never an assurance that it will be absorbed

edges.why_related: declining to answer a fact-specific question conversationally reads to the client as coldness and weakens the felt relationship retention depends on
edges.resolution_rule: the boundary holds without exception, but it is delivered as a same-day acknowledgement plus a scoped and priced answer path and a general answer where one genuinely exists, never as a bare refusal

edges.why_related: the highest-converting amendment marketing is precisely the outcome-promising free-review pitch the conduct rules forbid
edges.resolution_rule: conduct dominates absolutely: the line is sold on a written no-promise statement and a fee that does not vary with any amount recovered, and if the line cannot fill on those terms it is run smaller or not at all

edges.why_related: removing clients shrinks the book in the same planning pass that is trying to grow it
edges.resolution_rule: standards-based disengagement executes regardless of the growth target, and the capacity it frees is reallocated into the season's growth room in the same pass so it is recovered rather than mourned

edges.why_related: extension clients legitimately file months after the spring deadline, which is what makes an undated retention rate systematically understate returns
general education is the most reproducible way a small practice manufactures the proactivity force rather than waiting for it to occur
the debrief must complete before the sequence is written, or the contacts have nothing client-specific to carry
exit reasons must be gathered and classified before the annual review can read them against the mechanism map
classified exit reasons correct the map's assumption about which force was actually holding a departing client group
the annual review re-runs every live line through the filter and retires the ones that no longer clear it
both are recurring, externally dated, year-round commitments sold to the same small-business subset of the book, and both are staffed, capped and refused by the same logic

conflict_axes.name: retention_investment_vs_peak_protection
conflict_axes.description: The attention that builds trust and ease competes directly with the weeks that actually pay, and both claims are legitimate.
poles: invest in relationship depth all year
protect peak production above everything
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: schedule relationship work into the off-season blocks; during peak, retention is delivered through response time and accuracy rather than through extra contact

conflict_axes.name: offseason_revenue_vs_recovery_and_preparation
conflict_axes.description: Every quiet month contains billable work the practice could take and rest and preparation the next peak requires.
poles: fill the quiet months with revenue
protect the recovery and pre-season blocks
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: commit lines only against the working block's real weeks; the recovery and pre-season blocks are refused first rather than raided last

conflict_axes.name: helpfulness_vs_the_advice_boundary
conflict_axes.description: Answering the quick question is what a good relationship feels like and is exactly what the advice boundary forbids.
poles: answer the question because they are a client
require an engagement for anything fact-specific
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: acknowledge the same day, answer general classes freely with a source and a date, and convert fact-specific questions into scoped priced work with the workflow discipline behind it

conflict_axes.name: new_client_growth_vs_existing_book_service
conflict_axes.description: Every new client accepted consumes capacity that the existing book's response times and review depth were relying on.
poles: grow the book this season
hold the service level the base experiences
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: reserve expected returning demand first, fill only the computed growth room, and treat any acceptance beyond it as an exception requiring a named capacity addition

conflict_axes.name: persuasive_offer_vs_conduct_limits
conflict_axes.description: The off-season pitches that convert best are the fear-framed, outcome-promising ones the practice has forbidden itself.
poles: use the pitch that fills the month
hold the never-say list
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: conduct dominates without exception; convert on specificity, usefulness and a stated date rather than on fear, refund size or manufactured scarcity

conflict_axes.name: contact_frequency_vs_attention_fatigue
conflict_axes.description: Staying visible requires contact and contact spends the attention the one important message will need.
poles: contact often to stay top of mind
contact rarely so messages are read
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep few contacts, give each a real reason and a single ask, and segment so a message reaches only the class it is relevant to

conflict_axes.name: keeping_a_paying_client_vs_practice_standards
conflict_axes.description: The client pressing for a position the practice will not sign is often a long-standing and profitable one.
poles: keep the revenue and manage the pressure
disengage on standards grounds
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: standards win; the decision is made in the off-season on written grounds and notified early, never renegotiated under deadline pressure in the chair

conflict_axes.name: measurement_speed_vs_measurement_honesty
conflict_axes.description: The practice wants its retention answer at the spring deadline and the extension tail will not have filed by then.
poles: decide on the number available now
wait for the corrected number
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: publish the rate with an as-of date, mark it provisional, schedule the post-extension recompute, and hold irreversible decisions until the corrected figure exists

conflict_axes.name: line_breadth_vs_competence_depth
conflict_axes.description: A wider portfolio smooths revenue across more months and thins the competence and review behind each line.
poles: offer many off-season lines
run few lines properly
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: add a line only when the competence and review arms of the filter are answered by a named person, and retire lines the annual review finds no longer clearing them

conflict_axes.name: relationship_depth_vs_independent_perspective
conflict_axes.description: Producing a client's books deepens the relationship and removes the outside look the practice had when the numbers arrived from elsewhere.
poles: own more of the client's finance work
keep an independent look at the numbers
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: where the crossover is taken, name a different person to review the return against the books and record that separation as a condition of the engagement

edge_cases.description: A long-standing client goes silent for one whole season and reappears the next
edge_cases.trigger: a lapsed client files again after a gap year
edge_cases.mitigation: hold lapsed as a distinct state with a defined window, count the return against the cohort the client actually belongs to, and restate the prior season's rate with the correction shown rather than letting it quietly improve

edge_cases.description: A client sends a long, detailed question about their own situation in July and expects a free answer because they are a client
edge_cases.trigger: a fact-specific inbound question arrives on an informal channel outside any engagement
edge_cases.mitigation: acknowledge the same day, give the general-class answer if one genuinely exists with its source and date, and send a written scope and fee for the specific question; never answer it from memory in the reply

edge_cases.description: A client forwards a notice that, on reading the file, traces back to a mistake the practice itself made
edge_cases.trigger: an own-error matter enters through a revenue line's intake
edge_cases.mitigation: check the file before quoting anything; own-error matters move immediately into the return-workflow knowledge base's disclosure and correction path and are never billed as support or as an amendment engagement

edge_cases.description: A bookkeeping crossover client's monthly close falls in the first week of the filing peak
edge_cases.trigger: a recurring off-season deliverable collides with the protected peak block
edge_cases.mitigation: agree the peak coverage in writing at engagement - a deferred close, a named alternate performer, or a paused month - and where none of those is available, decline the line rather than absorbing it

edge_cases.description: A vendor's ready-made off-season newsletter arrives with audit-fear framing and a refund-maximising claim
edge_cases.trigger: third-party content enters the outreach mix
edge_cases.mitigation: check every message against the never-say list regardless of who wrote it, rewrite or drop the piece, and record the vendor as a source that requires review before each use

edge_cases.description: A partner offers a revenue share for access to the client list, and a client asks whether they get something for sending friends
edge_cases.trigger: a compensated referral or data-sharing arrangement is proposed
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse list sharing on any terms, and check whether compensated referral arrangements are permitted for the practice's credential class and jurisdiction against current published rules before agreeing anything at all

edge_cases.description: Aggregate retention looks steady while the simplest return class quietly empties out to self-preparation software
edge_cases.trigger: one segment collapses under a stable blended figure
edge_cases.mitigation: compute by cohort and segment as a standing practice and treat a segment collapse as a segment decision about who the practice serves, not as a reflex to discount

edge_cases.description: An extension client's missing document never arrives and the extended deadline is approaching
edge_cases.trigger: an extension return stalls with the governing date close
edge_cases.mitigation: escalate on dated written notice stating the obligation in the authority's own published terms, file only what can be defended, and decline to file rather than estimate an unsupported figure; record the pattern for the disengagement decision

edge_cases.description: An elderly client's adult child calls to arrange and discuss the parent's off-season work
edge_cases.trigger: a third party seeks to act for a client outside an authorization
edge_cases.mitigation: discuss nothing about the client's affairs without the client's own authorization in the form the disclosure rules require, give the client the time and patience the heightened-care rule calls for, and welcome family involvement once the authorization exists

edge_cases.description: The client with the largest invoice turns out to consume triple the expected hours and to pay only after several reminders
edge_cases.trigger: effort and payment data contradict a tier assigned on fee size
edge_cases.mitigation: re-rank on effort-adjusted contribution and handle it as a scope, timing and terms conversation in the positioning window, long before it becomes a disengagement question

edge_cases.description: A wave of referrals from one delighted client arrives after the season's growth room is already full
edge_cases.trigger: referral flow lands out of phase with the capacity plan
edge_cases.mitigation: hold a small reserve within the room for referrals from historically good-fit sources, and where the room is genuinely gone offer a dated next-season slot or a referral elsewhere rather than accepting work the practice cannot do well

edge_cases.description: The annual book review is held so late that none of its decisions can be implemented before intake opens
edge_cases.trigger: the review slips past the start of the pre-season block
edge_cases.mitigation: fix the review inside the working off-season block with a written decision set carrying owners and dates that all precede the pre-season block, and treat a missed date as a trigger to shorten the review rather than to skip it

workflow.action: Define the returning book, its counting unit and its client states
workflow.description: Write down what a client is, what counts as a return, and what active, lapsed and exited mean before any number is computed
workflow.artifact: written book definition covering unit, linked groups, return event and states
workflow.gate: a second person recomputing the prior season's list from the definition alone reaches the same count

workflow.action: Fix the off-season conduct, consent and advice boundaries
workflow.description: Set the never-say list, the disclosure-before-agreement rule, the heightened-care rule, the permitted-use position and the three-way classification of inbound questions
workflow.artifact: off-season conduct and permitted-use rule sheet with the advice-line classification
workflow.gate: all four are written, the permitted-use position names its obligation class with a rule source, a date and a re-verification date, and staff can state the never-say list without reading it

workflow.action: Run the post-deadline debrief while the season is still recoverable
workflow.description: Capture per-client friction, fee fit, extension cause and life changes, plus the practice-level bottlenecks, in a scheduled block
workflow.artifact: per-client debrief notes and a practice bottleneck note
workflow.gate: every client filed this season has a note or an explicit nothing-to-record marker, and the practice note names the weeks that broke

workflow.action: Measure retention by cohort and segment and classify why clients left
workflow.description: Compute the dated cohort rate with the post-extension recompute scheduled, then screen and work the lapsed list for exit reasons
workflow.artifact: dated cohort retention table and a classified lapsed list
workflow.gate: the rate states denominator, numerator, as-of date and recompute date, and every lapsed client is screened for non-signals with each controllable reason routed to an owning work unit

workflow.action: Rank the book on effort-adjusted contribution
workflow.description: Set fee against true consumed hours and adjust for payment behaviour, referrals and segment fit to allocate scarce attention and slots
workflow.artifact: internal tiering with its components shown per client
workflow.gate: tiers are reproducible by someone who did not assign them, contain no refund component, and carry no rule that varies accuracy, review depth or due-diligence handling

workflow.action: Position every retained client for next season
workflow.description: Tell each client what they do differently, what the practice does differently, and where the fee is heading on complexity grounds
workflow.gate: each note names all three items, references no refund outcome or competitor comparison, and promises nothing the capacity plan has not agreed

workflow.action: Decide who is not carried forward and notify them early
workflow.description: Apply the written practice-standard grounds, notify in writing well before intake, and offer the prior-document handover
workflow.artifact: disengagement list with dated written notices and handover records
workflow.gate: every entry names a written ground, a notification date preceding intake opening, and a completed handover offer, with no accusation in the notice

workflow.action: Filter and select the off-season line portfolio
workflow.description: Run every candidate line through authorization, competence, infrastructure and capacity and record an offer, refer or defer verdict
workflow.artifact: line portfolio with a dated four-part verdict per line
workflow.gate: each verdict is dated, the authorization item names the rule source and check date, and at least one candidate carries a refer or defer verdict

workflow.action: Stand up the extension book and work it in waves
workflow.description: Build the tracked list with next actions, owners and governing dates, sequence the waves, and classify each extension's cause
workflow.artifact: shared extension list with dated waves and cause classifications
workflow.gate: every extension client has a next action, an owner and a governing date recorded outside anyone's memory, and each carries a structural or behavioural cause

workflow.action: Assign every commitment to a capacity block
workflow.description: Place externally dated obligations first, then fit the lines and the contact sequence into the working block in weeks
workflow.artifact: year block plan with weeks assigned per commitment
workflow.gate: no commitment lands in the recovery or pre-season block, every accepted line names its weeks, and dated obligations are placed before discretionary work

workflow.action: Size the season's growth room and set the referral ask
workflow.description: Derive the room from capacity minus expected returning demand, set the allocation priority, and place the single plain referral ask at delivery
workflow.artifact: written growth room with an allocation priority and a source-recording rule at intake
workflow.gate: the room shows capacity, expected returning demand and remainder; every new client record has a source; and any referral inducement carries a dated permitted-arrangement check

workflow.action: Review the book and write the decisions
workflow.description: Assemble retention, churn, line performance and mix evidence, re-test each line against the filter, and decide next year's shape
workflow.artifact: written decision set covering lines, clients not carried, growth room and next-season sequence
workflow.gate: every decision has a named owner and a date, all dates fall before the pre-season block opens, and each live line carries a fresh eligibility verdict

priority_rationale: The frame work units come first because nothing downstream is safe or even meaningful without them: the book definition fixes the unit every later number counts, and the conduct, consent, advice-line and eligibility boundaries decide what the practice may say, to whom, and which lines it may run at all. Measurement and the post-deadline debrief follow, because retention, exit reasons, tiering and this season's captured friction are the only honest inputs to any off-season decision. The season-close work units - positioning, the contact sequence and disengagement - come next while the client's memory is still fresh and the change is cheapest to ask for. The off-season lines then run inside those boundaries and on that evidence, and capacity smoothing, referral generation and growth pacing come last among the operating units because they compose everything already committed into a year that still protects recovery, preparation and peak; the annual book review sits at the end because it is the only unit that can read all of the others at once and turn them into written decisions before the next season starts.

dominance_rules.rule: The conduct boundary dominates every off-season offer, message and pitch
dominance_rules.rationale: the trust it protects is the entire retention asset, and a single fear-framed or refund-promising message can cost more than the line it was selling ever earns
dominance_rules.trigger: any outreach, offer or upsell is drafted, from any source including a vendor template or an automated sequence
dominance_rules.action: strike every refund promise, refund comparison, fear framing and manufactured urgency, and every undisclosed fee, scope or performer, before it is sent; if the offer only works with that framing, the offer is not run

dominance_rules.rule: Permitted-use and consent rules dominate the wish to contact the whole book
dominance_rules.rationale: taxpayer information is a restricted class and a disclosure breach is not recoverable by apologising
dominance_rules.trigger: client information is about to be used for a promotional or related-service message, or shared with any third party
dominance_rules.action: confirm the use is permitted under the current rules of the practice's jurisdiction and against the client's recorded preferences; never share, sell or trade the client list on any terms

dominance_rules.rule: Authorization and competence dominate off-season revenue
dominance_rules.rationale: work the practice is not permitted or able to perform costs far more than the empty month it was meant to fill
dominance_rules.trigger: a slow month coincides with a line whose authorization or competence has not been verified this cycle
dominance_rules.action: apply the filter and take the offer, refer or defer verdict; a revenue gap is never a reason to skip the check or to rely on last season's answer

dominance_rules.rule: A fact-specific question dominates the impulse to be quickly helpful
dominance_rules.rationale: an off-hand answer carries the same client reliance and exposure as a signed return with none of the research or review behind it
dominance_rules.trigger: an inbound off-season question depends on one taxpayer's particular facts
dominance_rules.action: acknowledge the same day and answer only inside a scoped, priced engagement carrying the return-workflow knowledge base's research and review discipline

dominance_rules.rule: Own-error remediation dominates the amendment and notice revenue lines
dominance_rules.rationale: billing a client to repair the practice's own mistake destroys the relationship it was meant to monetise and disguises a defect the practice needs to see
dominance_rules.trigger: an amendment or notice traces back to the practice's own work on reading the file
dominance_rules.action: route it into the return-workflow knowledge base's disclosure and correction path, do not bill it as a line, and record it as a defect rather than as revenue

dominance_rules.rule: Protected capacity blocks dominate an attractive off-season commitment
dominance_rules.rationale: the recovery and pre-season blocks are what make the next peak survivable and accurate, and work taken from them is repaid with error classes in March
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposed line or client commitment would occupy weeks inside the recovery or pre-season block
dominance_rules.action: reschedule it into the working block, cap it to fit, or decline it, and record which of the three was chosen

dominance_rules.rule: The returning base's claim on capacity dominates new-client growth
dominance_rules.rationale: growth taken beyond the room is paid for out of the response times and review depth that hold the existing book, and the bill arrives a season later
dominance_rules.trigger: intake demand exceeds capacity minus expected returning demand
dominance_rules.action: fill only the computed room, and answer the rest with a dated next-season slot or a referral elsewhere rather than an acceptance

dominance_rules.rule: Practice standards dominate the revenue of a client who violates them
dominance_rules.rationale: the signature and the due-diligence record are the practice's licence to operate and are worth more than any single relationship
dominance_rules.trigger: a client presses for a position the practice will not sign, refuses the substantiation a credit or status requires, or abuses staff
dominance_rules.action: move the relationship into the disengagement decision with the ground recorded, notify in writing before the next season, and offer the prior-document handover

dominance_rules.rule: Externally dated statutory obligations dominate the practice's own off-season schedule
dominance_rules.rationale: an extension date, an estimate cycle date or a notice response date cannot be moved and its consequence falls on the client
dominance_rules.trigger: a dated obligation falls inside a planned block or competes with discretionary work
dominance_rules.action: schedule the dated obligation first and move the discretionary work, reading the current date and its requirements from the authority's own current publications for the client's jurisdiction

dominance_rules.rule: Honest measurement dominates a flattering number
dominance_rules.rationale: decisions taken on an undated or blended figure are worse than decisions taken with no figure at all, because they carry false confidence
dominance_rules.trigger: a retention rate or line performance figure is about to be reported or relied on
dominance_rules.action: state the as-of date, apply the post-extension recompute before anything irreversible, split by cohort and segment, and never substitute an outside benchmark for the practice's own history

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pin the counting unit and the client states before computing any retention figure
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a season of decisions built on a rate that changes the moment a different person pulls the list, and the re-argument that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the conduct, consent and advice boundaries before a single off-season message is drafted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retracting content that has already reached the book, and the trust damage a retraction cannot undo

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete the post-deadline debrief before the follow-up sequence is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: generic contact that says nothing specific to a client whose actual friction was never recorded anywhere

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run every candidate line through the four-part filter before it is mentioned to any client
anti_rework_rules.prevents: promising help the credential class does not permit and having to withdraw it mid-engagement in front of the client

anti_rework_rules.rule: Assign every off-season commitment to a named capacity block in weeks before accepting it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a recovery or pre-season block silently sold twice and a first peak week spent doing deferred setup

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the practice's own file before quoting any amendment or notice engagement
anti_rework_rules.prevents: invoicing a client for repairing the practice's own error and then unwinding both the invoice and the relationship

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record each extension client's next action, owner and governing date on the shared list the day the extension is filed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing the extension population from memory weeks before the extended deadline, at the worst possible moment

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ask for next season's structural changes in the positioning window rather than at intake
anti_rework_rules.prevents: renegotiating arrival dates, formats and expectations during peak, when every such conversation costs the most

anti_rework_rules.rule: Compute the season's growth room before new-client intake opens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a growth season paid for out of the existing book's response times, and a retention drop the following year that nobody attributes to it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture the source of every new client at intake rather than later
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding referral attribution from memory a year on, when the mechanism can no longer be read and the ask cannot be aimed

iteration_protocol.trigger: the post-extension recompute moves the retention rate materially
iteration_protocol.action: restate the dated figure, re-read the cohort and segment splits, and revisit every decision that was taken on the provisional number

iteration_protocol.trigger: classified exit reasons cluster on a single controllable cause
iteration_protocol.action: route the cause to the work unit that owns it, change the behaviour that produces it, and say so in the next positioning cycle

iteration_protocol.trigger: an off-season line overruns its assigned weeks or spills into the recovery or pre-season block
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the line through the capacity arm of the filter and cap it, restaff it, or retire it before the next cycle begins

iteration_protocol.trigger: credential, registration, consent, permitted-use or compensated-referral rules change, or a renewal cycle arrives
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify every affected line and every outreach permission against the authority's current publications and suspend anything that no longer clears

iteration_protocol.trigger: a client or staff member reports that an off-season message felt like pressure, a warning or a threat
iteration_protocol.action: pull the message, review it against the never-say list, and re-check the whole sequence and every third-party template for the same framing

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same relationship generates repeated pressure to take positions the practice will not sign
iteration_protocol.action: move it out of tiering and into the disengagement decision with the ground recorded, and notify before the next season opens

iteration_protocol.trigger: a season's new-client intake exceeded the computed growth room
iteration_protocol.action: measure the following season's retention for the existing base separately before repeating it, and re-derive the room from the corrected demand

iteration_protocol.trigger: one segment's retention falls while the aggregate holds steady
iteration_protocol.action: treat it as a segment decision about who the practice serves and what that segment receives, rather than as a pricing reflex

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same fact-specific question arrives from many clients across a season
iteration_protocol.action: convert it into general educational content with a dated source and re-check the advice line for that topic before publishing
